days.title: Southern Villages and the Way of Love
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Manarola
stops.detail: Continuing on the "Litoranea" road, you will later find the junction that descends to the hamlet of Manarola.

stops.name: Via dell'Amore
stops.detail: Then there is the coastal path number SVA, known as the Green Blue path (592), which connects Riomaggiore to Monterosso crossing all the villages of the Cinque Terre and taking on the appearance of the famous Way of Love in the stretch between Riomaggiore and Manarola.

stops.name: Corniglia
stops.detail: Since the central section of the "Litoranea" was never completed, to reach the villages of Vernazza and Corniglia, whether coming from Monterosso or Riomaggiore, it is necessary to use the narrow and winding road known as "dei Santuari" (SP 38) and the SP 51.

stops.name: Vernazza
stops.detail: All the locations of the Cinque Terre are equipped with individual railway stations and stops along the Genoa-Pisa route: Monterosso, Vernazza, Corniglia, Manarola, Riomaggiore.
